ModMetaData.name: Caravan Readiness
ModMetaData.author: CoolNether123
ModMetaData.description:
Caravan Readiness adds a live readiness report to the caravan hitching spot used by a forming vanilla caravan.
Its compact progress summary stays readable as the caravan fills. Review requested, loaded, carried, reserved, waiting, inaccessible, blocked, and unavailable cargo; check people, animals, and departure blockers; then click a row to jump to the relevant pawn or item.
The mod does not create a second staging system, change caravan jobs, or force departure. It observes the existing vanilla formation process and updates on a bounded cadence.
